name: navigate
description: Open a URL in the remote browser. url is an absolute http or https URL. A JSON or text page loads. Example: {"url":"https://example.com"}.

name: read
description: Read the current page as viewport screenshots, the way a person looks at the screen. max_viewports is an integer from 1 to 30, default 10, and is how many viewports to capture. One image is one viewport. When truncated is true, call again with a higher max_viewports to see the rest of the page. Example: {"max_viewports":10}.

max_viewports.description: Maximum number of viewports to capture. Defaults to 10.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the current viewport as one PNG. This tool takes no input fields. Example: {}.

name: handoff
description: Hand the live page to Benny, usually because it is a login wall. reason is why he has the browser. timeout is seconds to wait. done_when optionally names the page after sign-in with url_matches, selector_present, or text_present. url_matches ignores the query string and fragment. Only visible elements count. One call starts the share, notifies him, waits, and ends the share. Example: {"reason":"login wall","timeout":120,"done_when":{"url_matches":"https://app.example/home"}}.

reason.description: Why Benny is being handed the live browser.

timeout.description: Seconds to block while Benny has the browser.

done_when.description: Names the page after sign-in. Set url_matches, selector_present, or text_present. Polled about once a second. Auto-complete only after the condition has been false once and then true on two polls.

url_matches.description: Regular expression matched against the page URL without its query string or fragment.

selector_present.description: CSS selector for a visible element on the page after sign-in.

text_present.description: Substring of visible text on the page after sign-in.

name: click
description: Click an element on the current page. target uses placeholder, label, text, css, role and name, or point x and y from read viewport pixels. button, click_count, and modifiers are optional. Examples: {"target":{"placeholder":"Search Admin Resources"}} and {"target":{"role":"button","name":"Sign in"}}.

inputSchema.description: target is one locator or a point. The server also accepts a bare string as the target.

target.description: One locator key or a point. Precedence is placeholder, label, role, text, css, then x and y. nth and exact refine a locator. read gives viewport pixel coordinates for x and y.

exact.description: When true, text matches the whole string.

nth.description: Zero-based match in the winning frame.

x.description: Horizontal viewport CSS pixel from read.

y.description: Vertical viewport CSS pixel from read.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this offset before using x and y.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the click.

name: type
description: Type text into an element on the current page. text is the characters. target is optional. clear replaces the current text. press_enter presses Enter after typing. Example: {"target":{"label":"Email"},"text":"ada@example.com","clear":true}.

inputSchema.description: text is required. target is optional and uses the same locator keys as click.

target.description: One locator key or a point. Precedence is placeholder, label, role, text, css, then x and y. nth and exact refine a locator. read gives viewport pixel coordinates for x and y.

exact.description: When true, text matches the whole string.

nth.description: Zero-based match in the winning frame.

x.description: Horizontal viewport CSS pixel from read.

y.description: Vertical viewport CSS pixel from read.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this offset before using x and y.

clear.description: When true, replace the element's current text.

press_enter.description: When true, press Enter after typing.

name: scroll
description: Scroll the page or a container. dx and dy move the nearest scrollable ancestor at target. scroll_y or y is an absolute page offset. delta is {dx, dy} or a number down. to is top, bottom, left, or right. read gives viewport pixel coordinates for point targets. Example: {"dx":600,"target":{"x":756,"y":425}}.

inputSchema.description: dx and dy scroll a container. scroll_y or y scrolls the page to an absolute offset. A bare number is accepted by the server as scroll_y.

target.description: One locator key or a point. Precedence is placeholder, label, role, text, css, then x and y. nth and exact refine a locator. read gives viewport pixel coordinates for x and y.

exact.description: When true, text matches the whole string.

nth.description: Zero-based match in the winning frame.

x.description: Horizontal viewport CSS pixel from read.

y.description: Vertical viewport CSS pixel from read.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this offset before using x and y.

dx.description: Horizontal delta in CSS pixels. Positive moves toward the right edge.

dy.description: Vertical delta in CSS pixels. Positive moves down.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this absolute offset in CSS pixels.

y.description: Same as scroll_y. Absolute page offset in CSS pixels. Not a point coordinate.

delta.description: Relative scroll in CSS pixels. The server also accepts a number as dy.

dx.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels.

dy.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels.

to.description: Scroll to an edge of the page or the target container.

name: select
description: Choose an option in a select element. target is a locator or a point. Pass one of value, label, or index. Example: {"target":{"css":"select"},"label":"Green"}.

inputSchema.description: target plus exactly one of value, label, or index. value wins if more than one is set.

target.description: One locator key or a point. Precedence is placeholder, label, role, text, css, then x and y. nth and exact refine a locator. read gives viewport pixel coordinates for x and y.

exact.description: When true, text matches the whole string.

nth.description: Zero-based match in the winning frame.

x.description: Horizontal viewport CSS pixel from read.

y.description: Vertical viewport CSS pixel from read.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this offset before using x and y.

name: wait_for
description: Wait until the current page matches. Pass target and state, or text, or url_matches, or load_state. timeout_ms is milliseconds, default 10000. Example: {"target":{"text":"Ready"},"state":"visible"}.

inputSchema.description: One of target plus state, text, url_matches, or load_state. timeout_ms is optional.

target.description: Locator to wait for, with state. Precedence is placeholder, label, role, text, then css. A point is not a wait target.

exact.description: When true, text matches the whole string.

nth.description: Zero-based match in the winning frame.

scroll_y.description: Scroll the page to this offset before using x and y.

x.description: Horizontal viewport CSS pixel from read.

y.description: Vertical viewport CSS pixel from read.

state.description: Wait until the locator is visible or hidden.

text.description: Wait until this text is present.

url_matches.description: Regular expression matched against the page URL.

load_state.description: Playwright load state to wait for.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
